caption: The drawing depicts three small objects positioned near the center of an otherwise empty beige background. In the upper center group, there is a gold-colored ring with engraved decoration around the band and a central red gemstone. To the left of the ring, there is a simple oval object, outlined in black, resembling a plain ring with a raised central feature. To the right of both, there is a small horizontally oriented object, resembling a short, ornate nail or pin, also outlined in black. The line work is clean and precise, with only the gold ring filled in with color and the other two objects left as outlined sketches. In the bottom right corner, the name "M. Fenga" is printed in small letters.
title: Ring
